notes.title: Not Dead Yet
notes.notes: [p]It's been a while since I've updated the game, it's not dead or anything I've just been busy as shit. Had to buy a new pc since my old one died, get money, normal life crap. [/p][p]I've been slowly working on an update in the background but it's still not to the point where I would be happy making it public. If there are any bugs or other things that make you want to listen to the crab, please tell me. Most likely I've already fixed it for the next update but if not I'll include it. [/p][p]Still getting used to windows 11 and recovering stuff on my new pc as well, so there's that too.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542286/64049bffb31767ce479ed743bc538da5fde8f334.png"][/img][/p][h3]Expect an update to not come out until August or after August, still got shit to do.[/h3][p]                                                                                                                                           [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]                                                                                                                                      [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45542286/56c1cdab827ec265d8f9f847ddc5171b680666a6.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Small Content Patch Before I Disappear For A While Yeahhhh
notes.notes:
not a big update, but it fixes some big stuff.

Here's what changed:

- Fixed some collision errors that made game progress impossible
- nooses no longer crash the game
- the bums in the cemetery no longer vanish when you touch them 
- singular crabs now show pity on you and give you their xp after 4 turns and insult you (weakling)
- added tons of new items to craft obtained from various new crafting books
- other small changes and fixes that I didn't bother keeping track of :)

notes.title: Final Patch for now I hope
notes.notes:
I disabled the enemy scaling update for now because it broke player's ♂ amounts. If you experienced this please load a previous save when your ♂ did not read as NaN.

Once again, sorry guys ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Reminder: Never finalize an update while sleep deprived
notes.notes:
That was my bad guys, I just accidentally changed the spawn location during testing. If it happens again just yell at me and I'll fix it as fast as possible. Your saves are still there so don't worry.
Also I adjusted the xp formula for the enemy leveling system so you should be gaining xp again. If it continues having issues I will disable it until I figure it out more.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
- Fixed some collision issues
- Fixed Ring of Fumbling not being purchasable
- Heavily nerfed the enemy "get's stronger" ability and added a proper enemy scaling system to non boss enemies
- Rebalanced multiple enemies
- Separated Flesh Connection into two stats, one for physical attacks and the other for non physical attacks
- Gagged and Crucified the scarecrow because people complained about him too much (you did this to him)

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
I have a life and the game is made by just me. So next is just suffering through Steam support and trying to fix stuff for a bit. I'll work on another major update later but I need a bit of a break for now. As of now I've spent well over 600 hours working on the game. Hopefully soon the soundtrack will become purchasable and the demo will be playable so I can finally get some rest.

Thanks for all the support for the game, just remember it is still extremely early access. Most maps are under-developed visually and I'm still missing one full locker. 

If you guys want more to play from me I have two massive hundred hour long games on Bobox that also share the same world and lore of this game. You should find it easily on the website! ːsteamhappyː
